mutations.name: whitespace-spaces-only
mutations.what: only runs of spaces are folded, not newlines or tabs

mutations.name: no-nfc
mutations.what: NFD and NFC spellings of a text hash differently

mutations.name: no-trim
mutations.what: leading and trailing whitespace count

mutations.name: whitespace-erased
mutations.what: whitespace is removed instead of folded, so two joined words look unchanged

mutations.name: destructive-default-false
mutations.what: a missing destructiveHint is read as false

patches.old: destructiveHint: true, idempotentHint: false, openWorldHint: true
patches.new: destructiveHint: false, idempotentHint: false, openWorldHint: true

mutations.name: open-world-default-false
mutations.what: a missing openWorldHint is read as false

patches.old: destructiveHint: true, idempotentHint: false, openWorldHint: true
patches.new: destructiveHint: true, idempotentHint: false, openWorldHint: false

mutations.name: defaults-not-applied
mutations.what: annotations are hashed as written, without their defaults

mutations.name: enum-in-order
mutations.what: the order of enum members counts

mutations.name: type-list-in-order
mutations.what: the order of a type list counts

mutations.name: required-in-order
mutations.what: the order of required counts

mutations.name: default-normalized
mutations.what: a default value is normalized like a schema, so a change of its whitespace is missed

mutations.name: properties-not-a-map
mutations.what: the names under properties are read as keywords

mutations.name: keys-in-order
mutations.what: the canonical JSON keeps the order of keys

mutations.name: items-in-order
mutations.what: the order of tools counts

patches.old: for (const [key, fields] of collected.sort((a, b) => byText(a[0], b[0]))) entries[key] = fields;
patches.new: for (const [key, fields] of collected) entries[key] = fields;

mutations.name: prompt-arguments-in-order
mutations.what: the order of prompt arguments counts

mutations.name: annotations-not-hashed
mutations.what: annotations are not part of a tool's pin

mutations.name: mime-not-hashed
mutations.what: the media type is not part of a resource's pin

mutations.name: diff-every-field
mutations.what: the diff names every field of a changed item

mutations.name: added-as-removed
mutations.what: an added item is reported as removed

mutations.name: split-at-last-colon
mutations.what: the name of a resource is cut at the last colon of its URI

mutations.name: refusals-not-reported
mutations.what: refused items are not reported

patches.old: for (const refusal of list.refused) refusals.push({ kind: singular, ...refusal });

mutations.name: missing-kind-refused
mutations.what: a kind left out of the snapshot is refused instead of read as empty

patches.old: const list = raw === undefined || raw === null ? { ok: true, items: [], refused: [], refusedCount: 0, overLimit: 0 } : sanitizeList(plural, raw);

mutations.name: algorithm-ignored
mutations.what: a pin of another algorithm is compared as if it were this one

mutations.name: pinned-inverted
mutations.what: a different fingerprint is pinned

mutations.name: expected-ignored
mutations.what: an approval of what the owner did not see is accepted

mutations.name: unreadable-as-empty
mutations.what: a pin file that cannot be read is an empty store (and is overwritten on the next approval)

mutations.name: version-unchecked
mutations.what: a file of another version is read

mutations.name: corrupt-not-kept
mutations.what: a corrupt file is not copied aside

mutations.name: hash-unchecked
mutations.what: a record whose field hashes are not hashes is kept

mutations.name: reserved-ids-allowed
mutations.what: the server ids __proto__, constructor and prototype are accepted

mutations.name: ids-129
mutations.what: a server id of 129 characters is accepted

mutations.name: pins-not-updated
mutations.what: a written pin is not kept in memory

mutations.name: kept-before-write
mutations.what: a pin is kept in memory although writing it failed

mutations.name: not-serialized
mutations.what: calls run at the same time instead of one after the other

mutations.name: log-unguarded
mutations.what: a log that throws rejects the call and stops the queue

patches.old: try { writeLog(message); } catch { /* the log is best effort */ }

mutations.name: clock-ignored
mutations.what: the approval time does not come from the given clock
